notes.title: 1.2.0 Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010465/daa8cf365beeee45ebd4cb64f9ea9021dd491b95.png

I'm excited to announce the release of version 1.2.0 
Here are the new features and updates:

Important Note: As I mentioned before, I no longer have a VR headset. This update was made without a VR headset, so please report any bugs or issues you encounter on my Discord server.

[olist]
 Increased Max PC Connections: The maximum number of PC connections has been increased from 3 to 4 players!
 New PC Character 'Luminar': A new PC character, Luminar, has been added to the game
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010465/4c6184b4b11e334cb327e3ae1437577361e286aa.png
 Recenter Button: A recenter button has been added to the left wrist menu in VR to return to the starting point. (Not sure if it works)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010465/f4f923d6833c4736f8153544ffb21002b4570515.png
 Shield Ammo for VR: Added a new mechanic where the left trigger button can be pressed to shoot. If it hits a PC player, you regain health. Cooldown: 13 seconds. (Not sure if it works)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010465/8d738541f966220b4fd0b3c3345258e9f6662f81.png
 Changed Countdown Time: The countdown timer has been increased from 5 to 10 seconds.
 Balancing for 4 PC Players:

 GunBlade: If Alive PC Player is "4" -> ammo 6:7 (Phase 1: 6, Phase 2: 7).
 SkullShield: Will now block 250 times when there are 4 alive PC players. This adjustment applies only the first time and will not update every time a player dies.
 Crate Ornate: If Alive PC Player is "4" -> damage modifier = 2.3 (total damage = 821.1)
[/olist]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Now I might not have time to update Red Ruins further, except for fixing some bugs. Anyway, enjoy the update!

Best regards,
FallingMouse

notes.title: 1.1.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Balance:
VR players can no longer perform melee damage while grabbing the GunBlade. Now, melee damage can only be dealt when the GunBlade is thrown, not when it's being held.

Developer's Note:
Thank you for playing my game! "Red Ruins: Asymmetric VR vs. PC" is my first Unity game, and while it may not be perfect compared to similar games, I appreciate your support and feedback.

I had to return the VR headset that I borrowed for development, so I won't be able to make major updates or continue VR development for now. However, I'll do my best to fix any bugs or make some small updates that I can.

Thank You.

notes.title: 1.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Bug fixes since 1.1.0:

 fixed an issue where PC players couldn't perform dodge animations while shooting

Balance:

 adjust GunBlade ammo when 1 vs. 1 will be 2:2 (phase1 : phase2)

notes.title: Balancing Update
notes.content:
1.1.0 Main Feature:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010465/4ab690560e755d59a4c48bb376eb1b95aebbf611.png
[olist]
Balancing
GunBlade (ammo  : )

 Alive PC Player is "3" -> ammo 5:7
 Alive PC Player is "2" -> ammo 3:4
 Alive PC Player is "1" -> ammo 1:2

PC Caster Weapon (MagicDamage)

 Alive PC Player is "2" -> +137 MagicDamage
 Alive PC Player is "1" -> +213 MagicDamage

Healing Pickup (default heal: +750HP, cd: 90s)

 Alive PC Player is "2" -> +710HP, cd: 60s
 Alive PC Player is "1" -> +520HP, cd: 30s

Crate Ornate (default modifier = 2, damage = 357 * 2 = 714)

  Alive PC Player is "2" -> damage modifier = 1 (total damage = 357)
  Alive PC Player is "1" -> damage modifier = 0.5 (total damage = 178.5)

SkullShield (default durability: 150 times)
Note: This will only do for the first time, NOT UPDATE EVERYTIME the Alive PC Player left

  Alive PC Player is "3" -> 150 times
  Alive PC Player is "2" -> 50 times
  Alive PC Player is "2" -> 12 times

SkullShield can see HP and Durability bar
